scientific_integrity: Analytic polytope/facet proof, graph-intersection reduction and source-efficiency inequalities; exact rational finite diagnostics are supporting tests, not replacements for the all-dimensional proof. Scientific review is same-model only and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact quantitative illumination for type-D root polytopes only. Does not resolve the general three-dimensional upper-bound conjecture or other solids. A finite source configuration costs strictly more than the limiting infimum; historical originality risk from unindexed work and an inaccessible earlier paper persists.
title: Exact quantitative illumination of type-\(D_d\) root polytopes
